snippet.title: Cycle Maabou [Arcade Longplay] (1984) Taito Corporation
snippet.description: Full playthrough of the arcade game Cycle Maabou. Released back in 1984 by Taito Corporation. Japan release of the game. An excellent game with monocycle.
